content: Calpol is a well-known brand of pediatric medication available in the United Kingdom, Ireland, and India. The primary formulation of Calpol is a suspension containing paracetamol, which is typically presented as a sweet-tasting, colored syrup. This medication is commonly used for the management of fever and pain in children. In addition to the paracetamol suspension, Calpol is also available in a formulation containing ibuprofen, which is marketed under the name Calprofen. This provides an alternative option for pain and fever relief. In the United Kingdom, Calpol is widely accessible and can be purchased in most pharmacies and supermarkets. The paracetamol suspension is available in sachets with varying dosages tailored to different age groups: For infants aged 2-3 months, each sachet contains 5 mg of paracetamol. For children aged 5-12 months, each sachet contains 30 mg of paracetamol. For children aged 1-2 years, each sachet contains 50 mg of paracetamol. For children aged 3-5 years, each sachet contains 70 mg of paracetamol. For children aged 6 years and older, each sachet contains 150 mg of paracetamol. Calpol is also available in tablet form and in sachets, providing additional options for administration based on the child’s age and preference.
